name: Anthropic
description: Claude models over the Anthropic API with streaming, using a key you own.

name: OpenAI
description: OpenAI models through the OpenAI API, using your own key and billing.

name: Google Gemini
description: Gemini models through the Gemini API with a streaming adapter written in Rust.

name: OpenAI-compatible endpoints
description: Any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI chat API, including self-hosted gateways.

name: OpenRouter
description: Many models behind one OpenAI-compatible key.
note: Works through the OpenAI-compatible adapter with OpenRouter's base URL. No dedicated preset yet.

name: BytePlus ModelArk
description: A direct provider option where its documented endpoint and account terms permit.

name: Ollama
description: Detects an installed Ollama and reports installed and reachable separately. Models you pull run entirely on your machine.
note: Model download guidance from inside Vekrun is planned.

name: LM Studio
description: Detects LM Studio's local server and connects to models you have loaded.

name: llama.cpp-compatible servers
description: Any local server exposing an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
note: Point the OpenAI-compatible adapter at the local server.

name: Claude Code accounts
description: Optional compatibility for people who already subscribe, using only documented auth flows. Never a requirement for Vekrun's own agents.
note: Only if a documented, approved protocol exists at the time of implementation.

name: Codex accounts
description: Optional compatibility for existing Codex subscriptions through documented auth flows.
note: Only if a documented, approved protocol exists at the time of implementation.

name: Gemini CLI accounts
description: Optional compatibility for existing Gemini CLI accounts through documented auth flows.
note: Only if a documented, approved protocol exists at the time of implementation.

name: Linear
description: Assigned issues on the Board, Start Work from an issue, status and pull-request links synchronised back.

name: Jira
description: Jira issues on the Board with configurable status mapping to Board columns.

name: Asana
description: Asana tasks on the Board. Asana's remote MCP server needs a registered OAuth app, so this ships only once that registration exists.
note: Requires a Vekrun-registered OAuth app or your own app credentials.

name: GitHub Issues
description: GitHub issues assigned to you, on the Board next to tickets from other providers.

name: GitLab Issues
description: GitLab issues on the Board with merge-request link-back.

name: Git
description: Status, staging, diffs and commits run through the git you already have installed, so hooks and credential helpers keep working.

name: Git worktrees
description: Every ticket and every Factory task gets its own worktree by default, so parallel work never collides.

name: GitHub pull requests
description: A review inbox for pull requests requested of you and your teammates, with inline suggestions synchronised to GitHub.

name: GitLab merge requests
description: Merge requests in the same review inbox, synchronised to GitLab.

name: SSH remotes
description: Remote shells with strict host-key checking and fingerprint acceptance. Remote file editing and transfers come later.

name: Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell and WSL
description: PTY-backed shells on macOS, Windows and Linux. Shell integration marks provide exit codes and durations.
note: PowerShell and WSL pass CI on Windows; by-hand verification on Windows is pending.

name: Remote workers
description: First-party Rust workers on a machine you control, reached over SSH port-forwarding by default.

name: Language servers
description: Diagnostics and navigation in the built-in editor where a language server is available.

name: Linear MCP
description: Linear's hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP with OAuth or a bearer token.

name: Jira and Confluence MCP
description: Atlassian's hosted Rovo MCP server covers Jira and Confluence through one connection.

name: GitHub MCP
description: GitHub's remote MCP server with a personal access token, or the local server over stdio.

name: GitLab MCP
description: GitLab's hosted MCP server.

name: Slack MCP
description: Slack's hosted server. Slack requires a registered app, so this needs app credentials.

name: Notion MCP
description: Notion's hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP.

name: Sentry MCP
description: Sentry's hosted server, or the local server over stdio, for issue investigation.

name: Datadog MCP
description: Datadog's hosted MCP server.

name: Figma MCP
description: Figma's hosted server is gated to clients listed in Figma's catalog.
note: Unavailable until Vekrun is listed by Figma.

name: PostgreSQL MCP
description: A local server over stdio from a maintained community toolbox. The archived reference server will not be shipped.

name: Cloudflare MCP
description: Cloudflare's hosted MCP servers.

name: Supabase MCP
description: Supabase's hosted server, or the local server over stdio.

name: Stripe MCP
description: Stripe's hosted server, or the local server over stdio.

name: Custom MCP servers
description: Any remote or local MCP server you configure yourself, with the same per-server permissions as the presets.
